text:
aj: Quick async status — dedicated capacity buildout checklist before we lock week-of deploy. Please confirm ownership for the items I call out and flag any blockers.

aj: TL;DR: procurement ETA 5/9, racks in staging 5/12, firmware window 5/15-5/16, canary on 5/18. Need final owners for rack acceptance, burn-in, and rollback plan.

sara: I can own rack acceptance + cable manifest verification. Will post checklist by EOD.

ben: I'll take burn-in tests and smoke criteria. Can we reuse the same scripts from last wave? (link to repo: https://git.redwood/infra/gpu-burnin)

kevin: @ben yes — two minor tweaks: log rotation and nvlink test ordering. I'll open a tiny PR today.

maria: Procurement update: vendor confirmed shipment pickup 5/6, ETA datacenter 5/9. Reservation IDs: RES-93821 / RES-93822. Ops will confirm manifest on arrival.

aj: Great. Who's owning firmware window coordination with security/network? We need an outage plan and rollback steps documented.

kevin: I'll coordinate firmware. Planning a 90m window with staged reboots per rack, canary first rack. Need net team on standby for BGP flaps. @infra-bot can you schedule a config freeze on 5/14?

infra-bot: Scheduled: config-freeze from 2025-05-14T00:00Z to 2025-05-16T23:59Z. Notifying network and oncall channels.

ben: For burn-in, proposed acceptance criteria: 24h sustained power/perf, no ECC errors, nvlink loopback OK, 5% headroom on temp/power. Anyone object?

maria: Sounds good. Also, heads up — datacenter requires COI and insurance certs before equipment handshake. Legal has these ready; I'll attach to the manifest in the ticket.

aj: Owner checklist so far: rack acceptance = sara, burn-in = ben, firmware coordination = kevin, procurement ops = maria. Who's drafting canary traffic plan and fallback?

sara: I can draft a simple canary plan (1% traffic to new capacity -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%) and include automatic fallback to hosted. Will aim for draft by tomorrow.

kevin: For rollback, we'll tag model variants with fallback flag and route policy. Ops should confirm routing TTLs and cache flush.

maria: Reservation note: if any HW fails QA on arrival, vendor will swap within SLA 48h. We should plan capacity holdback for that contingency.

aj: Action items: 
- sara: post rack acceptance checklist (due EOD)
- ben: finalize burn-in scripts and criteria (due tomorrow)
- kevin: open firmware PR and draft outage plan (due tomorrow)
- maria: attach COI/insurance to RES tickets and confirm manifest on arrival (update on 5/9)
- infra-bot: config freeze already scheduled

aj: Small ask — if anyone has a spare H100 test node in staging earlier, tag me; want to run the quick nvlink loop prior to arrival.

kevin: We have one spare in staging-03, tagging @ben to claim.

ben: Claiming staging-03 now, will run nvlink script and report 1hr after.

maria: I'll ping vendor logistics to ask for early manifest scan and send proof of pickup.

aj: Thanks all. If no major blockers pop up, I'll schedule the kickoff meeting for 5/12 10am PT to align final steps. React with :thumbsup: if that works.

sara: :thumbsup:

ben: :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Meeting invite created: Dedicated Capacity Kickoff — 2025-05-12 17:00 UTC. Calendar invites sent to participants.
